newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a women's World Cup downhill on Saturday:
Overall World Cup wins: 2 - downhill: Lillehammer (96), Bad Kleinkirchheim (97)
Other feats - Silver medal in giant slalom at 1989 world championships, bronze medal in super-giant slalom at 1996 world championships.

Zurbriggen has been a regular on the circuit since 1985, mostly overshadowed by her older brother Pirmin, a former Olympic and world champion. She has often been the leader in World Cup races which have had to be called off.
